webster.text: A great fire or the burning of any great mass of combustibles, as a house, but more especially a city or a forest.

example.quote: And as to those mortal feuds which, in certain conjunctures, spread a conflagration through a whole nation, or through a very large proportion of it, proceeding either from weighty causes of discontent given by the government or from the contagion of some violent popular paroxysm, they do not fall within any ordinary rules of calculation.
